label: Design system / component library
summary: Foundations and components documented for reuse
preview_screen: A style tile: colour swatches with roles, the type scale, and one button, input and card in the proposed look.
required_states: Every component in default, hover, focus, active, disabled, loading and error where relevant
Every component at each size variant
design_guidance: Document each component's variants, states, sizes, and when to use or avoid it.
Name tokens by role (text-primary, border-subtle) and not by value.

checks: Every component shows all its states, sizes and themes, and no state is described without being shown.
Every text and background pairing lists its contrast ratio and meets WCAG AA, or is flagged.
Tokens are named by role, and no component uses a raw value that isn't a token.
Each component page states usage and an accessibility note.
